name: Elyndra Choir Crown
loreTies: Radiant Edict: structured actions reduce chaos effects and protect allies.
Elyndra Choir Crown is a colossal Empyrean deity shaped by existence survives through order. It manifests the Realm's law through battlefield-scale mythic force.
shortBackstory: Shekinah, Radiant Presence, is one of the four playable deities of the Empyrean canon. The lore remains the same; the playable form is now the source-realm divinity behind the mythology: feminine indwelling divine presence, holy fire, threshold awe, mercy that burns false order.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Elyndra Choir Crown began as more than a weapon in The Radiant Hierarchies. Elyndra Choir Crown was bound to a radiant archive seal during a Gate disturbance that tested whether existence survives through order could survive contact with the Hollow. The title carried in their name was earned when the Titan chose duty over spectacle and accepted a burden ordinary soldiers could not survive.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Empyrean, Elyndra Choir Crown is treated as proof that a radiant hierarchy of law, purpose, preservation, sacred geometry, divine halls, and anti-chaos governance can become battlefield doctrine without losing its soul. Their silhouette carries gold-white metals, celestial light, ordered winglike silhouettes, law sigils, halo-spine geometry, throne-like bodies, but their real identity is tactical: protection, order-locks, shields, anti-chaos control, battle lineless aura play. Every deployment makes faction philosophy visible through movement, restraint, and force.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Gate did not simply attack Elyndra Choir Crown; it tried to measure what their Realm values most. The wound echoed sacred doctrine back as bait, tempting the Titan to overextend, break battle line, or turn culture into raw fuel. Elyndra Choir Crown survived by refusing the Gate's terms, leaving a scar that still reacts whenever anti-chaos seals appears on the map.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In Storm-Oath Covenant, Elyndra Choir Crown gives the campaign a personal lens on faction survival. Their presence reinforces the rule that faction identity stays distinct unless a mission explicitly permits otherwise. In a one-active-deity Titan, Elyndra Choir Crown turns Radiant Edict from a passive rule into a story statement: the Realm is defending its meaning.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Elyndra Choir Crown's flaw is overcommitment to the belief that their Realm's answer must always be enough. NPC witnesses and rival factions challenge that certainty as the Hollow learns to imitate law, oath, balance, life, radiance, and ambition without understanding any of them. Their battlefield stats support this arc: HP 36, attack 10, range 3, speed 3, energy 3.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
mythicSource: source culture humans later copied as angelic and heavenly lore
visualCanon: Oriel is an edict-keeper formed by angelic hierarchy and living record law. Their glass tablets, bell-metal seals, layered halos, quiet dread, and wing geometry should feel like the origin of later angel-scribe legends.
